name: NeighborhoodQA
task: Given a paper's sampled citation ego-subgraph, name the SET of arXiv CS subject areas represented among its 1-hop neighbours.
output: free text; a variable-length list of area names

sampling.note: ground truth is computed on the SAMPLED subgraph, not the full neighbourhood, so the task is answerable from what is shown

node_text: node indices refer to ogbn-arxiv; recover title+abstract from https://snap.stanford.edu/ogb/data/misc/ogbn_arxiv/titleabs.tsv.gz via mapping/nodeidx2paperid.csv.gz
